snippet.title: Go Vacation - Coming October 11 for the Wii™
snippet.description: Go Vacation provides the opportunity to explore four different resorts on the island with over 50 activities and 100 different ways to play!  From surfing,  kayaking, scuba diving, skydiving, horseback riding, miniature golfing, sniping, fishing, skiing, snowboarding, skateboarding, street racing, dancing and much more.
